items.heading: Sancocho Panameno
details: Key ingredients: chicken, yuca, corn, culantro
Simmer chicken pieces with onion and culantro herb until fragrant.
Add yuca and corn on the cob.
Cook until the chicken and vegetables are tender.
Serve the hearty soup hot with rice.

items.heading: Ropa Vieja Panamena
details: Key ingredients: beef, tomato, bell pepper, onion
Simmer beef until very tender, then shred it.
Saute onion and bell pepper until soft.
Add tomato sauce and the shredded beef.
Simmer until thickened and serve over rice.

items.heading: Arroz con Pollo
details: Ingredients: rice, vegetables or protein, onion/garlic, oil, seasoning and water/stock.
Cook the rice by absorption or steaming.
Sauté the other ingredients separately, combine and season to taste.
